tweet_summary: A viral video presented earnestly ('Only God can do this 🙏') of a woman in a red dress beside a Ferrari being repeatedly drenched by passing snowplows while changing a tire. The clip is AI-generated.
why_note_decision: The video is AI-generated. The publisher's own Facebook post for the clip explicitly states 'This video recreates a real life scenario using AI, and the story is for your entertainment.' Many commenters call it out as AI. The tweet presents it as a real event with 8M+ views, so a note labeling the video AI-generated and citing the creator's disclosure is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS if the note clearly states the video is AI-generated (not a real Ferrari/snowplow incident) and cites either the original creator's AI disclosure (poweredbyperk Facebook post explicitly says it recreates a scenario using AI) or another credible AI-attribution source. Note must not assert the event happened. Avoid hedging like 'may be AI' if the source confirms AI.
reference_note: This video is AI-generated. The publisher's own caption on Facebook states it 'recreates a real life scenario using AI, and the story is for your entertainment.' No real Ferrari or snowplow incident occurred. https://www.facebook.com/poweredbyperk/posts/snow-plows-drench-ferrari-driver-during-roadside-tire-changebreckenridge-colorad/122165088716843451/

fact_check.notes: Facebook page for the original video explicitly discloses AI. Tweet video shows classic AI artifacts. Multiple commenters identify it as AI.

importance.lens_rationale: Harmless viral AI slop, but AI-labeling at scale matters for the broader epistemic ecosystem and is the bread-and-butter case for an AI notewriter.
